mapper.sql: security_id, trade_date, open, high, low, close, volume, amount, turnover_rate, pct_chg, average_price, suspension_flag, source, ingested_time
mapper.update: UPDATE market_facts_daily SET trade_date = #{tradeDate}, open = #{open}, high = #{high}, low = #{low}, close = #{close}, volume = #{volume}, amount = #{amount}, turnover_rate = #{turnoverRate}, pct_chg = #{pctChg}, average_price = #{averagePrice}, suspension_flag = #{suspensionFlag}, source = #{source}, ingested_time = #{ingestedTime} WHERE security_id = #{securityId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO market_facts_daily ( security_id, trade_date, open, high, low, close, volume, amount, turnover_rate, pct_chg, average_price, suspension_flag, source, ingested_time ) VALUES ( #{securityId}, #{tradeDate}, #{open}, #{high}, #{low}, #{close}, #{volume}, #{amount}, #{turnoverRate}, #{pctChg}, #{averagePrice}, #{suspensionFlag}, #{source}, #{ingestedTime} )
